AI Software Engineer

Job type: Full Time · Department: Software Engineering · Work type: On-Site

Fremont, California, United States

Job details
Application form
About Pebble
Pebble is a sustainable living startup defining a new way to live, work and explore from anywhere with a 100% electric, hassle-free RV trailer. Built by a team of experts in both automotive and consumer technology, Pebble combines electrification with cutting-edge automotive technology for a travel trailer experience that removes the hassles RV trailer owners have struggled with for decades.

At Pebble, we are building out the future of lighter, more flexible living. We see a world where your home can be anywhere you want to take it. Pebble blends the best of what it means to be at home, on the road, and off-grid into something useful and magical. If the idea of building out the future sparks your imagination and intersects with your skills, we’d love to meet you.

Position: AI Software Engineer

Experience Level: Entry-Level / New Grad (0–2 years)

Location: Fremont, CA

Department: Software Engineering

Role Overview
Join our SW team to build intelligent systems that power our electric vehicle platform. As a new grad or early-career engineer, you’ll develop AI agents for data analysis, automation, and user interaction while working with cutting-edge technology in the sustainable transportation space. This is a hands-on role where you’ll grow quickly, collaborate with experienced engineers, and see your work ship to production vehicles.

Core Responsibilities
Time Series Data Intelligence:

Build and contribute to AI agents that analyze vehicle telemetry and sensor data.

Support development of predictive models for vehicle performance, battery health, and maintenance scheduling.

Help create pattern recognition systems for fleet monitoring and optimization.

Contribute to scalable data processing pipelines for production vehicle data.

Data Infrastructure & Automation:

Help develop intelligent data migration and ETL systems with built-in validation.

Build automated database ingestion agents that parse and structure complex datasets.

Contribute to AI-powered data visualization tools that generate insights automatically.

Generative AI Applications:

Develop AI agents for internal tools (documentation, quality tracking, process automation).

Support customer-facing AI systems for vehicle support and diagnostics.

Work on multi-modal AI agents handling text, voice, and visual inputs.

Production Deployment:

Integrate AI solutions with existing software infrastructure.

Deploy and maintain AI agents in production environments.

Collaborate with engineering teams on AI-enabled vehicle features.

Monitor and optimize AI system performance at scale.

Required Qualifications
Experience:

0–2 years of experience building or experimenting with AI/ML systems (internships, research, coursework, or personal projects all count).

Bachelor’s (or currently completing a degree) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

Demonstrated curiosity and initiative in AI/ML through projects, competitions, or open-source contributions.

Technical Skills:

AI/ML: Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

Programming: Solid Python fundamentals.

Data: Exposure to databases, data pipelines, or time series data.

Infrastructure: Basic understanding of RESTful APIs and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP).

AI Specialization (coursework or project-level exposure):

Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering.

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases.

Agent orchestration and workflow automation.

Preferred Experience
Internship or research experience in automotive, IoT, or hardware industries.

Exposure to vehicle telemetry, CAN protocols, or embedded systems data.

Real-time data processing or edge computing projects.

Data privacy, security, and compliance knowledge.

What You’ll Get
Work on cutting-edge AI in sustainable transportation from day one.

Direct mentorship from experienced engineers and direct impact on product development.

Collaborative startup environment built for learning and rapid growth.

Comprehensive benefits package.

Professional development opportunities and access to modern tooling.

Modern Fremont office with flexible work options.

About You
Passionate about AI technology and excited to build practical, real-world applications.

Eager to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

Enjoy complex technical challenges and approach them with creative problem-solving.

Excited about sustainable technology and the future of mobility.

A strong collaborator who communicates well across technical and non-technical teams.

Ready to take ownership and grow your skills from prototype to production.
